name: transition-day pressure causes death
input: two adjacent one-day infections with death threshold one
test:
original = [[1, 1]]
assert simulate_transition_death(original, infectious_days=1, death_threshold=1, infection_threshold=2) == (1, [[3, 3]])
assert original == [[1, 1]]

name: threshold two blocks a lone source
input: one source next to two healthy cells
test:
assert simulate_transition_death([[1, 0, 0]], infectious_days=1, death_threshold=1, infection_threshold=2) == (1, [[2, 0, 0]])
assert simulate_transition_death([[1, 2, 0]], infectious_days=1, death_threshold=1, infection_threshold=2) == (1, [[2, 2, 0]])

name: threshold two infects between two sources
input: two one-day sources around a healthy cell
